duties.ownerWords:
F*UCKING WATCH THIS!QQQQ!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! 

reorganize duties have a 30 minute trigger that checks all this
duties.goal: Every minute of the last 30 runs clean: the Mac stays usable, no start or wake waits over 10 minutes, and no turn waits while slots are free. No open step sits with nobody moving it. On 10-15 and 10-16 all of these broke at once while no duty watched them together.

metrics.label: Minutes in the last 30 the system ran clean
Starts or wakes that waited over 10 minutes
Open steps in all chats that nobody moves
GB held by sessions idle past the idle window

duties.onMiss: Read the detail first. Each missed metric gets one fix job: if its plan step (duty "<dutyId>/<metricKey>") has a live job, message that job with this run's numbers; else start one with await rlm.create_session(brief, name=..., cwd="/Users/sieunpark/Documents/Github/sieun-pi") and set it on the step. Unusable minutes on the harness side and queue holds: the job fixes pi-pool's queue or the chat service's start path with a test and releases, and adds no RAM gate, hold or cap (c88). Unusable minutes on the app or owner side: tell this chat one line with the minutes and the owner, for ops guy. Stuck steps: message the chat that owns them with the step ids. Sleeping GB: the job fixes why those sessions escaped the idle unload (src/idle-unload.ts) with a test and releases (c92). Oversized processes: one line to this chat with the numbers. Never kill a session mid-turn or restart the Prime daemon or :5182. All on target: end with no message.
